text:
Ivy (Product): Quick sync on /keys UX before Friday release. Need to finalize empty state + rotate/revoke copy.
Rene (Design): Pushed a compact empty state that puts CTA center-left and examples on right. Thoughts?
Marco (Eng): compact is fine. note: key preview must auto-mask after 8s or when modal loses focus. no persistence.
Tess (a11y): prefer explicit text: 'This key is shown once and will be masked after you close this dialog.' ensure Show key button has aria-expanded and Copy uses aria-live.
Ivy (Product): good. on rotate vs revoke wording: users confuse them. propose labels: 'Rotate (create replacement)' and 'Revoke (remove access)'.
Rene (Design): I'll update microcopy and add an orange 'Rotating' pill state with tooltip and keyboard focus.
Marco (Eng): implement rotate as create-new + grace flag (default 3d). show 'Active until' on old key.
Sam (Support): surface Last used (UTC) in list row and an optional 'used by' tooltip listing up to 5 sanitized routes. customers ask this constantly.
Tess (a11y): modal focus order: title -> reason input -> confirm checkbox -> primary. Esc closes. Also avoid relying on color; add icons and text labels.
Ivy (Product): what about requiring typed confirm for high-risk orgs?
Marco (Eng): doable via org policy toggle. will add server flag.
deploy-bot: Deployed keyflow branch to staging. e2e tests running.
Sam (Support): I'll run a few manual tests and post edge-cases. tag me when staging link live. :white_check_mark:
